_meta.what: THE queue. Every ask, task, idea, and open decision lives here as a row. One file, so there is exactly one place to look and nothing can hide in a second list.
_meta.how_to_add: Every ask becomes a row IMMEDIATELY, never a prose note somewhere else. New rows use short human-slug ids (e.g. 'decide-launch-date') and keep the user's own words in 'verbatim'. Routing: doing-it-now or explicitly asked = task, someday-impulse = idea (parked by default), a call only the user can make = decision.
_meta.reconcile: At session-end sync, diff the session's actual work against open rows, flip statuses, and set verified_by (a commit, a file path, or a URL). type:decision rows stay surfaced in Your Move until answered; rows past their 'expires' date force-close at the weekly review.

types.task: execution work. status: todo | doing | blocked | done | archived | killed
types.idea: an improvement or new-build impulse. PARKED BY DEFAULT. status: parked | promoted | killed | done
types.decision: a call only the user can make. status: open | answered | expired
types.reference: a fact or link worth keeping. status: open | archived
types.bug: something broken. status: todo | doing | done | killed

row_schema.id: short human slug. The ONLY safe identifier. Never reuse one.
row_schema.code: PREFIX-N display label. NOT a safe identifier: a code freed by a clobber gets re-issued and then two rows share it.

_meta.caps: 250 rows / 300,000 bytes, enforced by brain/tools/brain-guard.sh at commit time. Rotate at 90% of cap, not on a schedule.
_meta.rotation: Move rows with a closed status dated before the current month to brain/history/queue-closed-YYYY-MM.json. Rotate, never delete.
